data.name: Aroor - SW
data.tagline: At Aroor Hospital at Alappuzha, SoftMind has 5 consultants available for you. This includes one male psychiatrist, three male psychologists, and one female psychologist. Our psychologists and psychiatrists are available from morning 10 am to evening 5 pm. Our basic approach includes non-invasive therapy and psychotherapy. For mild and medium cases, there is no need for medicines. For severe cases, we refer the client to our psychiatrist who will suggest medicines after the initial diagnosis.
